info.title: MetricFlow Public API
info.description:
Public API for Facebook Ads analytics, campaign management, and automation.

## Authentication
Pass your API key via header:
```
X-API-Key: mf_live_...
```
or
```
Authorization: Bearer mf_live_...
```
Create keys in [Settings > API](/settings?form=api-keys).

## Scopes
| Scope | Access |
|---|---|
| `analytics:read` | Overview, summary, daily breakdown |
| `ad_accounts:read` | Ad accounts list with metrics |
| `campaigns:read` | Campaigns, adsets, ads, creatives |
| `rules:read` | Automation rules and history |
| `rules:write` | Create, update, delete and pause automation rules |
| `entities:write` | Pause/enable, budgets, duplicate |
| `bundles:read` | Bundle configs and logs |
| `bundles:write` | Pause/resume bundles |
| `seeding:read` | Comment seeding: tasks, queue, author pages, images (Pro plan and higher or a custom plan) |
| `seeding:write` | Comment seeding: create/update/start/pause/delete tasks, upload images (Pro plan and higher or a custom plan) |
| `pages:read` | Fan pages, their comments and stats, comment-history scan jobs |
| `pages:write` | Moderate comments, page settings, webhook subscription, queue comment-history scans |

## Rate Limits
- **Read:** 120 req/min
- **Write:** 10-30 req/min
- **Daily:** depends on plan (Starter: 1K, Growth: 2.5K, Pro: 5K, Business: 20K)

## Date Ranges
Use `from` and `to` query parameters in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Defaults to last 90 days.

## Comment history scan
Facebook pushes only NEW comments over webhooks, so a delivery gap leaves a hole in a page's comment history and nothing re-sends it. A scan walks the page's posts and ingests what the webhook missed:

- **Catch up after a gap** — `POST /api/v1/pages/{page_id}/backfill` with `{"lookback_hours": 6, "mode": "apply"}`. Cheap enough to schedule: the window is pushed to Facebook and only posts that can plausibly carry new comments (live ads, recently-commented posts, posts created inside the window) are walked.
- **Decide comment by comment** — `mode="review"` stops the job in status `review`. Read the verdicts from `GET /api/v1/pages/backfill-jobs/{job_id}/items`, then post your decision to `POST /api/v1/pages/backfill-review/apply`. While a job waits in `review` the page's cleaner is paused for those comments, for up to 24 hours — cancel any review you are not going to apply (`POST /api/v1/pages/backfill-jobs/{job_id}/cancel`).
- **First-time cleanup** — `lookback_days` (0 = all history) walks the page's entire ad-post history. Thorough and slow; not for a schedule.

Scans are queued: the endpoints return a job, poll it via `GET /api/v1/pages/backfill-jobs/{job_id}`. One page can be scanned once every 30 minutes (429 with `Retry-After`, or `skipped_details` with `reason="cooldown"` in a bulk call), and one account can hold 50 queued or running scans at a time. The endpoints themselves allow 10 req/min (single page) and 2 req/min (bulk, up to 50 pages per call).

## Errors
| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 400 | Bad request |
| 401 | Invalid API key |
| 402 | Subscription expired — every endpoint except /usage and /me |
| 403 | Missing scope |
| 404 | Not found |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded |

## Calling from a browser (CORS)
All `/api/v1/*` endpoints allow cross-origin requests from any origin (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`) — no CORS proxy needed, and never route your key through one. Remember that a key embedded in client-side code is visible to anyone who can open the page: use a dedicated **read-only** key (`analytics:read` + `campaigns:read`) for browser dashboards and keep write-scoped keys server-side.

post.description:
Pause a campaign / adset / ad.

**Recommended:** pass `?async=true` (default for new integrations) to enqueue the action on the worker and get an immediate 202 with a `job_id`. Poll `GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}` for completion. The synchronous path (default for backward compatibility) blocks until Facebook responds — calls can take 30+ s under FB rate-limit pressure and may time out client-side.

get.description: Poll the state of a single- or bulk-entity action job queued via `?async=true` on any `POST /api/v1/entities/.../{pause|enable|budget|bid|bid-strategy}` endpoint, via `POST /api/v1/entities/bulk/status`, or a creative edit via `POST /api/v1/entities/{id}/edit` / `bulk/edit` (action_type=`edit`). Status progresses through pending → running → success / partial / failed / expired. Per-entity outcomes appear in `results` once the worker finishes (or partially finishes) the job.
